definitions.gloss: unlucky day; inauspicious day; most unfavorable day
definitions.explanation: The most inauspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Weddings, celebrations, and business openings are typically avoided on this day.

examples.japanese: {仏滅|ぶつめつ}の{日|ひ}は{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid days that fall on butsumetsu.

examples.japanese: {仏滅|ぶつめつ}に{結婚式|けっこんしき}をすると{安|やす}くなることがある。
examples.english: Weddings on unlucky days can sometimes be cheaper.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{仏滅|ぶつめつ}の{日|ひ}には{大事|だいじ}なことを{始|はじ}めないようにしている。
examples.english: My grandmother avoids starting anything important on unlucky days.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Despite the name containing {仏|ぶつ} (Buddha) and {滅|めつ} (destruction), {仏滅|ぶつめつ} has no connection to Buddhism. It is part of the {六曜|ろくよう} system, a folk calendar tradition. Younger generations tend to care less about {仏滅|ぶつめつ}, but it still influences wedding and event planning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}の{日|ひ} (an unlucky day)
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}を{避|さ}ける (to avoid unlucky days)
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}{割引|わりびき} (butsumetsu discount — offered by wedding venues)
